annotations.title: Dispute an unfair or unlawful review

description: The dispute desk. Used when the trade says a review is unfair, untrue, from someone who was not their customer, blackmail ("refund me or I leave 1 star"), or contains private details, abuse or something legally wrong. It settles the dispute straight away from fixed rules (no person reads it, except legal notices) and returns verdict ("review_stays" or "sent_to_nero"), why, what_you_can_do and usually an example_reply the trade can adapt for their public reply. A genuine customer's opinion is never removed, because hiding real negative reviews is banned by UK law (DMCC Act 2024); private details and swearing are already removed by machine before any review is published. Reasons: not_true, customer_was_to_blame (for example they were out, or changed the job), asked_for_money_or_threatened, not_my_customer, not_about_this_job, personal_data, abusive_language, legal_notice (a solicitor's letter or court order; put the details in note). The review stays visible and counting whatever the verdict.

note.description: Optional. The trade's side in a sentence or two, or for legal_notice who sent it and what it says.
